name: Four-pool memory allocation envelope
description: Find four continuous nonnegative memory allocations satisfying a declared total budget and minimum quotas. This is a constraint problem, not actual GPU allocation or measurement.
assumptions: Budget 10 GiB and quotas 3,2,1,1 GiB are authored illustrative requirements, not current laptop telemetry or recommended allocations.
Pool labels describe hypothetical independent requested allocations; these are not the actual sizes of Dawnwood's operator or scratch buffers.
All four axes have scale 1 GiB. This defines a continuous Euclidean relaxation; byte/page granularity and heap constraints are not modeled.
Any driver overhead, reserved memory or external consumption must already have been removed when authoring the budget.
Vulkan budget reports are estimates and do not guarantee an allocation. This solver neither queries the device nor allocates the reported pools.
One explicit feasible witness is [3,2,1,1], totaling 7 GiB.
